2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 481 of 2019,

3. As per the prosecution case, the petitioner and the co-accused persons are alleged to have tortured the complainant mentally and physically and ousted her from the matrimonial home due to non-fulfillment of demand of Rs. 5 Lakh as dowry.
